sourceLocationId.description: FK to Location.id — the warehouse a stock-tracked line is issued from on confirm (inventory-sales-issue-cogs-trigger REQ-003). Per-line override supported via `lines[].sourceLocationId`. When unset anywhere, the SalesDispatchStockIssueService falls back to the InventoryStock row with the largest available quantity for the SKU.
sourceLocationId.title: Source Location ID

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. Cancelled before shipment — any StockMove issued by this delivery on confirm is reversed via the existing StockMove.cancel transition (inventory-sales-issue-cogs-trigger REQ-006).

cancel.label: Cancel delivery
cancel.description: Cancel a delivery that has not yet shipped. Reverses any StockMove already issued on confirm per REQ-006. Not permitted once shipped.

allowNegativeStockOnDispatch.description: Per-administration policy toggle (inventory-sales-issue-cogs-trigger REQ-005): when false (default), confirming a Delivery whose stock-tracked line exceeds available InventoryStock quantity at the resolved warehouse is denied. When true, confirmation proceeds and the resulting negative on-hand condition is logged as a structured warning instead of blocking. Matches the block-by-default intent already documented in inventory-stock-tracking.
allowNegativeStockOnDispatch.title: Allow Negative Stock On Dispatch
